claim: The verifier must answer the speed latch's IN 0x253B from a NextREG model instead of replaying it from the recording or counting it as a port access.

evidence.text: The verifier answers IN 0x253B from its NextREG model (_NS.sel / nr_read); an IN (0x253B) taken as a game input made the replay fail at once.
evidence.quote: The verifier answers IN 0x253B from its NextREG model (_NS.sel / nr_read).

evidence.text: The verifier failed 'port access in a hook' on the latch's IN (0x253B); it now answers it from its NextREG model (_NS.read) instead of counting it as a port access.
evidence.quote: latch's IN (0x253B) from its NextREG model (_NS.read) instead of counting it as a port access.
